* Body

Sam and Mira joined a video call with Stripe's developer-support team to align on token expiry semantics. Stripe confirmed that refresh tokens are valid for twenty-four hours but recommended a proactive rotation strategy at the nineteen-hour mark. They also clarified webhook signature tolerance windows, which fed directly into the auth refactor requirements. Sam committed to a staged rollout timeline by end of week.
